description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's handling of missing objects in rev-list, including scenarios with missing objects, tags, branches, and various edge cases. It sets up repositories, manipulates object files, and verifies Git outputs under different conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that is expected to succeed, running the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the executed command must fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to be run after a test completes, typically cleanup actions.

methods.name: test_oid_to_path
methods.description: Converts a Git object ID to its corresponding file path in the objects directory.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for equality.
